methods.A: exact momentum-space reduction: Schwinger masters with the heat-kernel cutoff (masters.py), Gaussian loop integration, numerator identity |k|^2 Dhat(k) = e^{-eps k^2}, localisation constant for the K_eps-contact graphs, Fourier lemma (fourier.py); sympy exact arithmetic
methods.B: position-space Schwinger-time representation of whole graphs: every edge D_eps(r) = int_eps^inf (4 pi t)^-2 exp(-r^2/4t) dt (and derivatives), internal vertices integrated exactly as Gaussians (sympy), overall Schwinger scale integrated exactly (lower incomplete gamma), eps -> 0 asymptotics a log eps + b by Hepp sectors with an exact subtraction of the logarithmic sectors (b as convergent integrals, Gauss-Legendre); SE, QU, B, OC, T in closed form; finite-eps evaluations and least-squares extrapolation as confirmation. No momentum-space bubble reduction, no dimensional regularisation, no IR regulator.

findings_with_disposition.claim: Prop prop:herm (Hermiticity of the reflection form)
findings_with_disposition.method: line-by-line check against ch08 def:c8-Theta, thm:c8-fields (ii),(iii), def:c8-2pt
findings_with_disposition.comment: Each step follows from thm:c8-fields (ii) (W^Theta = W(J^Theta) for even J-prime = J + t1 a^Theta + t2 b), Theta^2 = 1, F^Theta(0) = F(0)^c and the order reversal of c. Gap: the two-point function uses the renormalised O(eps) = O - d_delta I^CT(O); reflection compatibility of the OPERATOR counterterms (d_delta I^CT(O^Theta) = d_delta I^CT(O)^Theta) is needed and is not among the stated hypotheses (it follows by the uniqueness/reality argument of thm:c8-fields (iii), but should be stated). The graded symmetry used is [tp, lem:t-elem (iii)], not readable by me.
findings_with_disposition.disposition: accepted and applied: the reflection compatibility of the operator counterterms is now listed as a hypothesis, with the justification from thm:c8-fields (ii)-(iii) (uniqueness of the singular part)

findings_with_disposition.claim: Thm thm:hermrad (Hermiticity of the one-loop radial form)
findings_with_disposition.method: line-by-line check against ch08 def:c8-radial, prop:c8-C, def:c8-inner
findings_with_disposition.value_found: conclusion follows under its hypotheses; one justification is incorrect as written
findings_with_disposition.comment: The claim that the formal exponential e^{s delta^hbar} "terminates on each component of fixed weight" is not correct: the classical part of P_n - K_n acts on operators at x != 0 as a first-order differential operator mixing all derivative orders (finite conformal flow), so the series in s does not terminate. The needed identity <e^{-s delta}F, G> = <F, e^{s delta}G> follows instead from d/ds <e^{-s delta}F, e^{s delta}G> = 0 using the infinitesimal Ward identity on the flowed observables, PROVIDED the flow exists on renormalised observables and keeps the supports disjoint for s in [0, pi/4] (true classically by prop:c8-C). The Ward identity itself is [tp, thm:t-ward] (H1-H4), and the vanishing of Lambda^(0)-exact two-point functions is [tp, cor:t-exact]; neither could be read by me.
findings_with_disposition.disposition: accepted and applied: the "terminating series" sentence is replaced by the differential argument d/ds <e^{-s delta} F, e^{(s-sigma) delta} G> = 0 from the infinitesimal Ward identity, with the existence of the flow on renormalised observables with disjoint supports for s in [0, pi/4] added as a hypothesis

findings_with_disposition.claim: Prop prop:ip0: radial Gram matrix = minimal-scheme two-point coefficient at unit separation
findings_with_disposition.method: consistency with ch08 def:c8-inner and def:c8-radial
findings_with_disposition.value_found: consistent only if the frame P_1 = 0 is reached through the arity-one finite counterterm theta_P = -1/3 (which does not enter the arity-zero two-point function), not through a finite part psi of the operators
findings_with_disposition.comment: def:c8-radial gives P_1(O) = -(1/3 + theta_P) units on the scalar bilinears; if instead P_1 = 0 were imposed by the finite part psi' = (a_P/2){S(Delta),-}, the two-point coefficient would change (remark: a finite part m adds 2m), and in a scheme with P_1 = a_P{S(P_b),-} def:c8-inner multiplies by 1 - 2 a_P w. The proposition defers to [ip, prop:ip-frames (a)] and [ip, thm:ip-origin], which I could not read; this step is unverified.
findings_with_disposition.disposition: accepted and applied: the frame P_1 = 0 is now stated to be reached through the arity-one finite counterterm along P_b (which does not change the arity-zero two-point function), with the alternative (finite parts of the operators, factor 1 - 2 a_P w) stated
